title: HuddleMessage (one line of a huddle's messages.jsonl)
description: profiles/<slug>/huddles/<h_id>.messages.jsonl: one compact JSON object per line, appended (never rewritten) by Store.appendHuddleMessage from append() in src/huddle/huddle-changing.ts. Type HuddleMessage in src/core/types.ts. Saved keys are masked in the line. Readers read on from the last byte offset and read a shorter file again in full; a missing mentions reads as []. Unknown fields must be kept.

seq.description: 1, 2, 3... per huddle; the huddle file's seq is the highest.

from.description: Sender's handle, stamped by the daemon; "system" for system messages.

mentions.description: Handles mentioned with @handle; "all" for @all. Older lines may lack it.

source.description: Posts only; system messages have none.
